paragraphs.text: Will Hindmarch is a writer and designer for games, fiction, comics, cards, and more. He's the creative lead of Level Eater Adventures and co-founder of Gameplaywright, publisher of Robin D. Laws' book Hamlet's Hit Points . More of Will's work can be found at the DMs Guild.
Hindmarch wrote the five-episode D&D adventure accompanying Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms on Magic Story .
